import os
import math
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as irrlicht
import roslibpy

# =============================================================================
# ROS Manager Class
# =============================================================================

class ROSManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.client = roslibpy.Ros(host='localhost', port=9090)
        self.client.run()
        
        # Driver inputs storage
        self.throttle = 0.0
        self.steering = 0.0
        self.brake = 0.0

        # Initialize subscribers
        self.control_sub = roslibpy.Topic(
            self.client, '/controls', 'std_msgs/Float32MultiArray',
            self._on_controls)
        self.control_sub.subscribe()

        # Initialize publishers
        self.clock_pub = roslibpy.Topic(
            self.client, '/clock', 'rosgraph_msgs/Clock')
        self.odom_pub = roslibpy.Topic(
            self.client, '/vehicle/odometry', 'nav_msgs/Odometry')

    def _on_controls(self, msg):
        self.throttle = msg['data'][0]
        self.steering = msg['data'][1]
        self.brake = msg['data'][2]

    def publish_clock(self, time):
        self.clock_pub.publish(roslibpy.Message({'clock': roslibpy.Time(time)}))

    def publish_odometry(self, vehicle, time):
        chassis = vehicle.GetChassisBody()
        pos = chassis.GetPos()
        rot = chassis.GetRot()
        vel = chassis.GetPos_dt()
        ang_vel = chassis.GetWvel_par()

        odom_msg = {
            'header': {
                'stamp': roslibpy.Time(time),
                'frame_id': 'odom'
            },
            'child_frame_id': 'base_link',
            'pose': {
                'pose': {
                    'position': {'x': pos.x, 'y': pos.y, 'z': pos.z},
                    'orientation': {'x': rot.x, 'y': rot.y, 'z': rot.z, 'w': rot.w}
                }
            },
            'twist': {
                'twist': {
                    'linear': {'x': vel.x, 'y': vel.y, 'z': vel.z},
                    'angular': {'x': ang_vel.x, 'y': ang_vel.y, 'z': ang_vel.z}
                }
            }
        }
        self.odom_pub.publish(odom_msg)

    def shutdown(self):
        self.client.terminate()

# Main Simulation
# =============================================================================
